reason: A testing and debugging plugin that statically checks DeepSeek-compatible tool-calling requests and recorded streams for protocol, schema, configuration, and assembly errors.

summaries.zh: 用于静态检查 DeepSeek 兼容工具调用请求及录制流数据中的协议、架构、配置和拼接问题。
summaries.en: A static checker for protocol, schema, configuration, and assembly issues in DeepSeek-compatible tool-calling requests and recorded streams.

capabilities: Static validation of OpenAI-compatible request JSON and message histories
Static inspection of recorded SSE and JSONL streams
Detection of tool-calling, reasoning-content, schema, configuration, and streaming assembly issues
Text, JSON, and SARIF report generation
